product: acer Nitro 5 Intel Core i5-9th Gen 15.6" (39.62cms) Display 1920 x 1080 Thin and Light Gaming Laptop (8GB Ram/1TB HDD/Windows 10 Home/GTX 1650 Graphics/Obsidian Black/2.3 Kgs), AN515-54
text: I buyed this laptop a week ago. Till now Its performance is great. Its 1TB with optane memory version. Even without ssd performance is great and the best thing about this lapi is that there is a lot of room for upgrade. Mostly boot timing is around 9-10 or 12 secs. Which is pretty good without ssd. Heavy gaming can be done on this lapi with ease and about built quality. Its great it isn't that much of bad I was expecting it to be bad but qulaity was good and finish was smooth.Battery life is the only downside in this lapi but again you should play games with charger plugged in if want best performance. For normal use its battery is enough. I charge it in every 3.5 to 4 hrs of use. But while gaming it might not last more than 1.5 hr maybe. And it doesn't heat much. Overall I'm satisfied with the product till now. Will update if found anything or once upgraded ssd into it

text: No doubt its a very good value for money laptop in which if you get it in under 55k i bought for 54k,its worth every penny The Issues are minor only 1.Color accuracy in Panel was not so good I mean not bad just average 2.Charging is very long 3.Some of the peices comes with heavy screen Bleeding Issue but I got good One. 4.I would say this is a perfect entry level gaming laptop. 5.Fan noise little louder 6.Inbuilt speakers literally buy Earphone for better gaming experience 7.Battery Backup upto 5hours for normal usage,heavy gaming upto 2.30 hours.I think its for this price 8.If you have enough time and money wait for Next gen for this laptop Any way It was a value for money laptop

product: acer Nitro 5 Intel Core i5-9th Gen 15.6" (39.62cms) Display 1920 x 1080 Thin and Light Gaming Laptop (8GB Ram/1TB HDD/Windows 10 Home/GTX 1650 Graphics/Obsidian Black/2.3 Kgs), AN515-54
text: I am writing this review after 2 months of intense usage of this laptop. At this price range this is the best laptop that you can buy. I had previously used Dell 5570, which was an expensive laptop and I wasn't very sure of Acer brand, but this laptop completely changed my mind. Best part of this laptop 1. screen quality is amazing 2. thermals are great. with the Nitro Sense app you can get the best out of this laptop. 3. design is attractive 4. screen bezels are thin (which enhances the look of this laptop) 5. Optane memory 6. GTX 1650 there are almost no downsides to this laptop. some people in the review section complain about the screen bleeding issue. Little bit of screen bleeding is visible, but also remember how less you are paying for such a powerful laptop. and the screen bleeding issue is not at all noticable in normal use of the laptop, it is seen only when you take a screen bleeding test. Built quality is also above average. I dont know why so many people are complainig about that. and dont be afraid to buy this laptop just because you think you will receive a defective piece. Amazon has 15 days replacement policy. and also acer gives year warrenty. hope my review was helpful (typed this review 15 before my online test :-))
